title: Quiz
description: A comprehension check for one Docket item: 3 to 5 multiple-choice questions about what the item's official text says. Every question names the option the text supports and quotes the passage that supports it, with a link to where the passage is published. A quiz may mix hand-written and generated questions, so each question says where it came from. Owned by Arena. A quote must appear word for word in the named field of the Docket item; JSON Schema cannot check that, so every consumer verifies it before showing the question.

item_id.description: The Docket item the questions are about.

origin.description: seed: written by hand and checked against a recorded snapshot. rules: generated by a deterministic rule set from the item and the snapshot it came from.

generator.description: The rule set or seed set that produced the quiz, with its version.

answer.description: The id of the option the official text supports.

evidence.description: The passages that support the answer, each quoted word for word from one field of the Docket item.

field.description: Path to a text or number field of the Docket item: names and array indexes joined by dots, for example title.fr, agenda.0.steps.1 or votes.counts.Oui.

quote.description: Copied word for word from the field, in the field's language.

url.description: Where a resident can read the passage: the item's official page or one of its documents.
